items.title: Cyber Insurers See New Divide: AI Defense 'Haves' & 'Have Nots'
items.description: Dark Reading Confidential Episode 23: Cyber insurers share their view of the AI-driven threat landscape and how mounting challenges are putting pressure on both sides of the policy, leaving the current model unsustainable.

items.title: Microsoft Declares Code Red After Historic 24-Hour Outage Disrupts Outlook, Teams and Copilot
items.description: Microsoft has declared an internal “Code Red” after a nearly 24-hour Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook, Teams, Copilot and Exchange Online on November 12 and 13, 2026. Reuters reported that the company is making it a top priority to prevent major service failures and recover faster when they happen. CEO Satya Nadella publicly apologized. items.title: CIA and ODNI Reportedly Suffer Cyberattack Exposing Unclassified U.S. Intelligence Information
items.description: The Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) recently discovered a cyberattack that exposed some unclassified U.S. intelligence information. The intrusion affected a shared network used to analyze publicly available material. items.title: Satellites Have a Ground-Level Cybersecurity Problem
items.description: Weaknesses in the ground-based infrastructure supporting satellite services are becoming more consequential as a new space race gathers pace.

items.title: Webworm APT Slithers Into Networks With Customized SoftEther VPN
items.description: The China-aligned espionage group rebuilt the open source VPN software from source, stripping out the artifacts that would normally expose it to defenders.
